description: Content surface with spacing, header and elevation levels.

howToUse: Use it to group content about one subject on a surface: a summary, a form section, a chart with its title.
Open it with CardHeader for title, description and action. Use `elevation` 0 or 1 on pages and higher values only for things floating above.
When the whole card opens something, put a link or button inside it: the card itself is not clickable.
alternatives: A destination in a list: NavCard.
Content with image, facts and actions: ContentCard.

keyboard.action: The card does not receive focus. The links and buttons inside it do.
